issues.description: The template for the Lights-Out exercise (ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py) declares the state_preparation method parameter state_of_lights as type 'str', while the problem statement and the solution expect a list of integers (list[int]) representing the board (e.g. [0,0,1,1]). Within the same template file the grover_circuit method already expects state_of_lights: list[int], so the inconsistent type annotation in state_preparation is contradictory and likely to confuse students about the expected input type. This mismatch could lead students to implement the helper method incorrectly (e.g., parsing a string instead of using a list) or to spend time reconciling the conflicting type hints.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the template method signature and its type hints so state_preparation accepts the same type used elsewhere: change state_of_lights: str to state_of_lights: list[int] (and update any related docstring to state 'list[int]'). This makes the template consistent with the problem statement examples and the provided solution, preventing student confusion.
